turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, support line. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My internet has been dropping every few minutes since yesterday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's frustrating. Have you tried restarting the modem?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Are the lights on the front solid or blinking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The middle one is blinking orange.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That points to a signal problem on our side. I'll book a technician visit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The earliest slot is Thursday between 8 and 12.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done. You'll get a confirmation text shortly.
